Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability due to a missing buffer size check, resulting in a heap buffer overflow write. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted HFS+ partition file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device.
Discoverer: Simon Scannell, a Google security engineer
Impacted Systems: Secure Endpoint (formerly Advanced Malware Protection, AMP)
Secure Web Appliance (formerly Web Security Appliance)
Attack Vector: Submitting a crafted HFS+ partition file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device
